concept.title: People facing serious illness or bereavement
concept.shortdesc: People affected by cancer, terminal illness or the death of someone close, and their families.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People grieving after the death of someone close, including those bereaved by suicide or sudden death and those who need practical help after a death.
: People with a life-limiting or advanced illness, or needing palliative and end-of-life care, and their families.
: People who have or have had cancer, and the family, friends and carers who support them or have lost someone to it.
